Class Expression

java.lang.Object
sys.pro.Expression
Direct Known Subclasses:
BinaryExpr, Number, Parenthed, Variable
public abstract class Expression extends Object
Abstract base class for all symbolic arithmetic expressions.

    • eval

      public int eval(String vars)
      Evaluates this expression using a string of variable assignments.

      The string format is "name = value" pairs separated by semicolons, for example "x = 1; y = 2". An empty string means no variables.

      Parameters:
      vars - variable assignments, or an empty string
      Returns:
      the integer result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the string is a variable is missing
